complaint: The fiber connection disappears at roughly the same hour after sunset, even after power cycling the equipment.
Our connection stays online but file transfers are far slower than the subscribed package.
The supplied gateway repeatedly powers down without anyone touching it.
A fee I cannot identify has appeared on the monthly cellular statement.
The bank confirms my invoice payment, yet your portal still marks the balance overdue.
A recently issued prepaid card is recognized by my handset but has never joined the network.
Voice conversations disconnect in places where I normally have coverage.
Calls work, but no apps can use cellular internet despite an active allowance.
My phone lost all service upon arriving in another country even though I bought a travel option.
I purchased prepaid credit and received a receipt, but the balance remains unchanged.
I can no longer enter the customer portal and the recovery message never arrives.
Internet is down for several neighboring homes, so this seems bigger than my own equipment.
My connection is unreliable and I cannot tell whether the box or the line is responsible.
The phone displays bars, but neither calling nor browsing works after I changed devices.
A charge and a missing payment appear on the same statement, and I need both checked.
The account app says my travel pack is active, but I still have no data abroad.
